text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
—I see, so that is the situation Bitter 
Glasse finds herself in.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
At first, it worked more than well enough. 
No matter the pace, no matter the 
opponent, she would break out from her 
usual spot at the end and overpower them.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, now that the other Umamusume 
around me have grown, running the way I 
used to either leaves me with no stamina 
at the end or gets me overtaken from 
behind.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Should we hone her core strengths further, 
or build adaptability to handle any 
situation— I need some basis to decide 
which direction to steer.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text: So that is why you came to visit.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...While there are many definitions of a 
"strong Umamusume," the simplest is surely 
one who can win any race.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
What is required there is the flexibility 
to calmly read the race and deduce the 
optimal solution, along with the 
adaptability to actually carry it out.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
If you wish to secure more victories, 
training that hones not only physical 
capability but also tactics would be 
optimal.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...I suppose it was bound to turn out this 
way.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...However, making that choice also means 
you'll have to change the way you 
currently run.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: ...Of course... I understand.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
............ Thank you very much. I will 
think it over from here.

text_block_list.name: Byerley Turk
text_block_list.text:
...It is not only the Umamusume who must 
be strong. Never, ever forget that...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(Even now, Bitter Glasse's training 
regimen carries a much heavier load 
compared to others...)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(On top of that, if one seeks to gain the 
physicality needed to overpower everyone 
around them, it will require a 
corresponding amount of training...)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(Knowing her, she would still try to push 
through. Saying "more, even more" if it's 
to get stronger...)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text: (However—)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
“...... Just sitting around like this is 
only going to waste time, isn't it.”

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Bitter Glasse. I need to speak 
with you.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Huh...? Yes, what is it?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"I heard your thoughts the other day 
regarding our current struggles. About how 
you want to become stronger and win."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
So, regarding tomorrow's training... I am 
thinking of altering your training menu.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: A change...?

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Until now, we've built everything upon 
your greatest weapon: your physicality.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, the reality is that my current 
weapons aren't enough to contend with my 
opponent's strength.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
That is why I am considering whether we 
might find a way to strengthen you from an 
angle other than the physical.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
In other words... instead of training, 
training, and endlessly training like 
before...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Take your current running style: even when 
your race strategy falls apart, you force 
your way through by sheer willpower.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
However, now that our opponents have grown 
stronger too, we can no longer simply 
overpower them by brute force.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If that is the case, I want to acquire a 
running style that can adapt flexibly to 
the developments of the race— a more 
sophisticated set of tactics.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
Whether the pace is fast or slow. Where 
the other Umamusume position themselves 
and when they make their moves... I want 
to run in a way that can adapt to any 
situation.

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
If we need to devise a strategy to break 
through the current situation, we should 
employ one with a higher probability of 
victory.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
A plan with a high win rate... but 
still...

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"Could you please think about it for a 
moment? About what it means to win."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
"If you try to win through physicality as 
you have before, it will inevitably come 
with risks."

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
It is not that I wish to crush you... I 
wish to make you win.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: You want me to win... .........

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
"Rumors say Trainer Kashimoto is harsh, 
but it's totally the opposite! She watches 
over us really closely!"

text_block_list.name: Little Cocon
text_block_list.text: ...Yeah, that's right.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text:
I'll give it a shot with that new training 
menu. Because... I really do want to 
win...!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
...Thank you very much. I shall also do my 
very best to support you.

text_block_list.name: Bitter Glasse
text_block_list.text: Yes!

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(It's all right, you will surely learn how 
to win.)

text_block_list.name: Riko Kashimoto
text_block_list.text:
(For we have an ally known as wisdom that 
will surely make it possible...)
